subject: StratoWorks sell-with / entitlement packaging and private-offer path
messages:
From: Ari Kessler <ari@stratoworks.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, CloudSalesOps <cloudsalesops@aws-partner.com>
Date: 2029-09-01T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Sell-with packaging + entitlement path for StratoWorks listing

Hi Naomi / Redwood team,

Thanks for the quick intro — excited to get StratoWorks into the marketplace with a sell-with (co-sell) packaging that plays nicely with Private Offers. We put together a short overview of the proposed SKU bundle and suggested entitlement map (attached). High-level asks from our side:

- Confirm entitlement gating approach (resale vs. sell-with) and any SKU patterns required for meter mapping.
- Clarify private offer workflow and expected DocuSign flow for AWS/Azure/GCP private offers (we got different guidance from each cloud).
- Identify the minimal technical evidence you need for listing (metering shim, auth flow, sample logs).

Is there a recommended intake checklist at Redwood for sell-with bundles? Would love to set a 30-min sync next week with your partner ops + marketplace tech (Ben / Soojin?).

Attaching: StratoWorks_Marketplace_Pack_Overview.pdf, logo.ai

Thanks —
Ari Kessler
Head of Partnerships | StratoWorks
ari@stratoworks.com

--

[Attachment stubs: StratoWorks_Marketplace_Pack_Overview.pdf (presentation), logo.ai (vector)]
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Ari Kessler <ari@stratoworks.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-09-01T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sell-with packaging + entitlement path for StratoWorks listing

Hi Ari — great to meet you and thanks for the overview. We’re very interested in a sell-with + private offer route for StratoWorks. I looped in Ben (Partner Ops) and Soojin (Marketplace tech) to surface the exact intake and evidence needs.

Quick answers / asks from our side:
- We do support sell-with and private offers across AWS/Azure/GCP; the entitlement mapping is the main friction point we can help streamline.
- Can you confirm whether StratoWorks plans to meter consumption via a proxy (our preferred pattern) or via cloud-native metering (SKU-based)? That determines the evidence bundle we request.
- Please share your preferred times for a 30-min sync next week (we have windows Tue/Wed 10–12 PT).
- Also please put the HubSpot deal id (if you have one) in the thread so we can link tickets — saves back-and-forth.

Look forward to the sync.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com

Date: 2029-09-02T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sell-with packaging + entitlement path for StratoWorks listing

Thanks Ari — happy to drive the commercial intake. A few items I want to surface ahead of our call:

1) Deal + pricing: If you can confirm the target list price and any introductory discount for private offers we can model revshare and attribution.
2) Private offer mechanics: Which cloud(s) do you want Private Offers enabled on first? AWS private offers typically need a 2–3 business day review for entitlement mapping; Azure/GCP timelines vary.
3) Contracting: please indicate whether StratoWorks has an existing reseller agreement with us or if we should prepare a one-off co-sell amendment.

Attaching a short MAP (mutual action plan) and sample term sheet so we can align commercial milestones before engineering gets into metering details.

Proposed next steps: 30-min sync Wed 2029-09-04 10:00 PT. If that works we’ll send a calendar invite and HubSpot will be updated with deal SW-2029-0842.

Attachments: StratoWorks_CoSell_MAPlan.xlsx, pricing_term_sheet.pdf

Regards,
Ben Carter
Director, Partner Operations | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Ari Kessler <ari@stratoworks.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-09-02T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sell-with packaging + entitlement path for StratoWorks listing

Hi all — adding the technical checklist so engineering can hit the ground running after we nail the commercial plan. Minimal evidence we typically request for sell-with + private offer: 

- Metering approach: proxy-based or cloud SKU. If proxy-based: sample proxy logs for 3 sample requests (timestamp, customer_id, usage_units).
- Auth flow doc: OIDC/SAML patterns and refresh token behavior for joint demos.
- Entitlement map: CSV of SKU -> feature flags, and mapping to Redwood product SKUs.
- Test account: a sandbox tenant with one admin user + sample API key (expires 30 days).
- Billing webhook endpoint and sample payloads (to validate ingestion).

Requested artifacts (attach to HubSpot or Drive): metering-schema.json (attached), sample_log.txt, entitlement_map.csv, test_account_instructions.md.

I can run a 30-min tech intake on Wed 2029-09-04 10:30 PT (immediately after the commercial call) to validate the artifacts. Proposed demo slot: Tue 2029-09-10 10:00 PT to present the integrated flow (joint engineering + sales).

Next steps summary:
- Ari: confirm metering approach + share HubSpot deal link (SW-2029-0842).
- Ben: circulate MAP and term sheet (done).
- StratoWorks: provision sandbox tenant and the artifacts listed above to Drive.

Thanks —
Soojin Lee
Marketplace Integrations Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.com
